timing_definition: Per-question agent loop on GPU, including generation and tool waits; excludes image build, model download/load and readiness warmup
notes: Same first five questions and pinned model/seeds as the paired RAG cohort.
All predictions are model-generated; no fallback answers were substituted.
Correct Masco answer can be calculated from the numbers supplied in its question.
Forced guesses can be correct by chance and do not establish memorization; low accuracy cannot rule out all pretraining contamination.
